en-NG.Biểu đồ là reconstructed theo vintage củ: The chart is reconstructed according to the vintage of each release. Release is immutable; correction has its own revision and reason. The first publication record for the new date is saved separately from when the calendar is enabled, without making the backfill history as-published. Still an Experimental study, not yet completed the 30-day shadow.
en-NG.C1 dùng âm % tăng cung: tăng cung ròng t: C1 reverses the 30-day supply growth rate: lower net growth produces a higher relative-scarcity score. C2 assigns a higher score to rising labeled exchange balances. These are research hypotheses; London/Merge/Dencun and changes to exchange labels affect interpretation. Custom scores reweight the selected Core 10 metrics to 100%; an empty selection or any missing metric returns null.
en-NG.Mức tương đối của giá, định giá, khan hi: The score compares ETH price, valuation, relative supply scarcity, exchange balances and network activity with their prior history. A higher value places a metric nearer the high end of its historical range. E2 and E7 both come from the MVRV family; the components are correlated, and predictive value has not been established.
en-NG.Giá trị dẫn xuất theo đơn vị gốc, có thể: Values are shown in their original units and may be negative. Each metric is normalized separately for Core 10. E2 shares the valuation group with MVRV; the directions assigned to supply and exchange balances are research hypotheses documented under Methodology. This page retains the raw values for reference.
en-NG.Core 10 tích hợp E2, nguồn cung và số dư: Core 10 incorporates E2, supply change and exchange balances. This experimental score ranges from 0 to 100; E2 shares the valuation group with MVRV. The directions assigned to supply and exchange balances are research hypotheses. See Research for exploratory results. Components are correlated; this is not a probability model.
en-NG.Ngày quan sát là ngày UTC của nguồn, kết: The observation date is the source's UTC date, ending at midnight the following day. Only use the closed date. Job scheduled to run at 10:17 and check again at 14:17 Vietnam time; Source data may arrive slowly. When there is an error, keep the valid release and report the status.
C1/C2 require all 31 calendar days from t−30 through t. Missing days remain blank; values are not filled or smoothed across gaps. Exchange balances rely on identified address labels, which may be revised; flash flags mark provisional data. Net change is not total deposits or withdrawals.
en-NG.Normalizer dùng q05/q95 tuyến tính của t: Normalizer uses linear q05/q95 of up to 1,460 previous calendar days, at least 365 valid raws, excluding date t from fit. Missing any required components then Core 10 is null; no fill. Three new features use the full raw schedule from July 30, 2015.
en-NG.Khám phá chủ sở hữu, thay đổi số dư và d: Explore holders, balance changes and exchange flows. Select Ethereum when comparing; distinguish entity labels, bridges and staking contracts. Arkham is being evaluated as a supplemental source and is not part of Core 10.
en-NG.Giá 37,5%: E1/E5/E6 mỗi 12,5%. Định giá: Price 37.5%: 12.5% each for E1/E5/E6. Valuation 37.5%: 18.75% each for E7/E2. Network 25% is split evenly across exchange, supply, address and transfer families; exchange share and exchange balance change each receive 3.125%, and the other three families receive 6.25% each.
Test combination: 75% Core + 25% one proxy. Difference using same-day and 90-day paired bootstrap, 10,000 times. Publishing a study does not necessarily mean it has demonstrated predictive power or independence.
en-NG.E2 và E7 chia nhóm định giá 37,5%; hai p: E2 and E7 share the 37.5% valuation group; the two exchange metrics share the 6.25% exchange group. C1 measures relative scarcity; C2 measures net change in labeled exchange balances. E3/E8/E9 proxies keep separate formulas; E4 remains R&D.
